pdf_metadata.Title: The Rise of Negative Earnings and Demand Shifting Investment

content_metadata.title: The Rise of Negative Earnings and Demand Shifting Investment
content_metadata.summary: This paper documents the rise of negative earnings among US firms from 1980 to 2019, exploring the increase in both the percentage of firms reporting losses and the persistence of these losses. It presents a model that rationalizes these phenomena through supply and demand shifting investment, revealing significant aggregate implications on GDP.
